desc: The stretch of FM 1485 between Huffman and New Caney in rural east Texas is where Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum and Colby Landrum reported encountering a large diamond-shaped object venting flame on the night of 29 December 1980, escorted by numerous helicopters. It is the most legally consequential site on this board, because the three plaintiffs did what almost no other witnesses have done - they sued the United States. Cash v. United States, No. H-84-348, was filed in the Southern District of Texas and dismissed on 21 August 1986 after the government showed that no agency operated such a craft. The medical records generated by the plaintiffs' injuries remain the field's best-documented physiological evidence.
